authoritative_data: The package catalog owns identity, dependency and semantic compatibility; one package version ties core entities/rules, operations, codecs, validation, UI and rendering contributions.

allowed_dependencies.rule: Direction is owner depends on these public contracts/ports; concrete adapters are wired only by composition hosts. GUI/CLI/script clients cannot link document/application; no Qt/VTK/SQLite/MCP types in core public interfaces.
allowed_dependencies.authority: docs/architecture/module-dependencies.json plus engineering-skeleton-proposal.md logical responsibility target; additions require future actual build graph verification.

extension_points: Static registrars compose the six groups; package core is framework-free.
Optional GUI/render targets consume contracts/SDK and are assembled by hosts.
Every contribution has tests and manifest compatibility constraints.
state_failure_version_rules: This is an L1 draft design contract: no compiled public consumer, BP execution, L2 integration or capability completion is asserted by this file.
All document mutation uses the shared coordinator, document/epoch/revision checks and atomic persistent history; GUI/script/AI cannot bypass it.
Unimplemented advanced capabilities report unavailable; data/reference errors never become a partially committed model.
Only the Nastran controlled subset is a QCAE production profile; the other twelve reference packages remain inventory evidence.
Disabled package operations are unavailable/absent; missing handlers never count as available.
Whitespace/comment changes preserve semantic digest; build fingerprints may differ.
Incompatible unit/field/rule semantics reject activation or use explicit migration; no latest-definition fallback.
